scientific_integrity: The proof uses uniform short-normal-coordinate expansions, radial cutoff integration, exact Dirichlet integrals, and Gauss--Bonnet; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth compact connected boundaryless Riemannian surfaces, with fixed metric.
Surface-dependent little-o remainder; no finite-sample recovery stability.
Round sphere case is covered implicitly by a previously published full distribution.
Historical priority for the general manifold coefficient remains provisional.
title: The short-perimeter law of random geodesic triangles determines Euler characteristic
